About Siemens Energy
--------------------

Siemens Energy is one of the world’s leading energy technology companies. The company works with its customers and partners on energy systems for the future, thus supporting the transition to a more sustainable world. With its portfolio of products, solutions and services, Siemens Energy covers almost the entire energy value chain – from power generation and transmission to storage. The portfolio includes conventional and renewable energy technology, such as gas and steam turbines, hybrid power plants operated with hydrogen, and power generators and transformers. A majority stake in the wind power subsidiary Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy (SGRE) makes Siemens Energy a global market leader for renewable energies. An estimated one-sixth of the electricity generated worldwide is based on technologies from Siemens Energy. Siemens Energy employs 96,000 people worldwide in more than 90 countries and generated revenue of around €31 billion in fiscal year 2023.  
  
Siemens Energy is a trademark licensed by Siemens AG

As the Employee Engagement Director at CHS Inc., Steven Brantner leverages over two decades of experience in communications strategy development and public relations to foster a culture of high performance and inclusivity within the organization. In his current role, Steven leads a dynamic team dedicated to crafting and implementing integrated employee communication and engagement strategies that not only attract top talent but also nurture and retain a diverse workforce. His expertise in corporate communications and strategic communications allows him to serve as a trusted advisor to business and functional leaders, ensuring that the CHS mission of creating connections to empower agriculture is effectively communicated throughout the organization.  
  
Steven's key projects include the development of innovative employee engagement initiatives that utilize storytelling and social media communications to enhance internal messaging and promote a sense of belonging among employees. By harnessing his skills in event planning and management, he has successfully orchestrated numerous corporate events that foster collaboration and celebrate employee achievements. Additionally, his proficiency in crisis communications ensures that CHS is well-prepared to navigate challenges while maintaining transparency and trust with its workforce.  
  
With a commitment to cross-functional team leadership, Steven actively collaborates with various stakeholders to align employee engagement strategies with broader organizational goals. His passion for empowering employees and enhancing workplace culture positions him as a pivotal figure in driving CHS's success in the agriculture sector, ultimately contributing to a more connected and engaged workforce.

About RVOS FARM MUTUAL INSURANCE COMPANY
----------------------------------------

At RVOS Farm Mutual Insurance Company, we're proud to say we are not your run-of-the-mill insurance company. RVOS was started over 100 years ago with the goal of providing peace of mind to Texas farmers and ranchers. It all started when a small group of local farmers pooled their resources to start a basic fire insurance protection program. They saw the great wisdom in sharing the burdens that so often accompanied the tragedies so common in that day and age.  
  
Since our founding, the RVOS Farm Mutual Insurance Company has grown from a single company offering a basic fire insurance policy to a group of companies uniquely positioned to expediently address our ever-changing market conditions. The companies offer innovative and competitively priced insurance products to meet the needs of property owners across the state.  
  
Today, RVOS continues to provide peace of mind to home owners, farmers and ranchers across the state. We have over 60,000 members relying on us to be there for them when they need us most. We are a rock solid company with over $13 billion of insurance in force. See our capital adequacy and financial stability ratings online at www.ambest.com and www.demotech.com. In over a century of insuring Texans we have never strayed from our founder's vision of providing security and peace of mind to our policyholders who are in fact our owners.

About Time Inc.
---------------

On February 1, 2018, Meredith Corporation (NYSE: MDP; meredith.com) acquired Time Inc. We now reach 200 million consumers who come to us for today’s biggest stories and innovative experiences from the most trusted, iconic brands.  
  
Meredith has been committed to service journalism for 115 years. Today, Meredith uses multiple distribution platforms — including broadcast television, digital, print, mobile and video — to provide consumers with content they desire and to deliver the messages of its advertising and marketing partners through 30+ media brands.  
  
Meredith is a leader in creating content across media platforms and life stages in key consumer interest areas such as celebrity, food, lifestyle, home, parenting, beauty, fashion, news and sports. Meredith also features robust brand licensing activities including more than 3,000 SKUs of branded products at 5,000 Walmart stores across the U.S. and at walmart.com., as well as innovative business-to-business marketing solutions provided by Meredith Xcelerated Marketing.  
  
Meredith's Local Media Group includes 17 television stations reaching more than 11 percent of U.S. households. Meredith's portfolio is concentrated in large, fast-growing markets, with seven stations in the nation's Top 25 and 13 in Top 50 markets. Meredith's stations produce 700 hours of local news and entertainment content each week, and operate leading local digital destinations.

About SMA Solar Technology AG
-----------------------------

Innovative and sustainable key technologies are prerequisites for renewable energy supply. More than 3,500 employees from 18 countries work to ensure that SMA is actively helping to promote the production and development of PV system technology worldwide.  
  
SMA is the only inverter manufacturer worldwide that offers the right inverter for every module type and system size ; for small residential systems, medium-sized commercial systems and large-scale plants; grid-connected photovoltaic systems; and off-grid and hybrid systems.  
  
SMA also develops technologically leading system solutions and is on the leading edge of the energy of the future, in areas such as intelligent optimization of self-consumption, grid integration of solar power and integration of batteries for more effective use of renewable energies.

Leading with purpose, Hearst is always moving forward. With a commitment to the highest quality in our products and services, we’re investing in healthcare solutions to help improve patient outcomes and technology that curbs emissions. Our brands are providing vital analysis, data and software to the global financial services industry; delivering important service and investigative journalism; and inspiring audiences with sports and entertainment programming. And we are dedicated to serving the communities it operates in, both civically and philanthropically.

Quinn begins the series as the girlfriend of the football team’s quarterback and is also a member of the cheerleading squad, the Cheerios. Despite her seemingly perfect façade, Quinn struggles with her own inner demons and insecurities, which emerge as the series progresses. Quinn’s character is also notable for its navigations of identity and societal expectations. In conclusion, Quinn Fabray is a complex and compelling character whose journey is marked by resilience, growth, and the complexities of adolescence. Her portrayal by Dianna Agron is nuanced and captivating, as she navigates through themes of love, identity, and personal challenges. The Villanova community helps students grow intellectually, professionally and spiritually and challenges them to reach their full potential. The University draws students from 45 states and nearly 50 countries. About Villanova University
--------------------------

Villanova University was founded in 1842 by the Order of St. Augustine. To this day, Villanova's Augustinian Catholic tradition is the cornerstone of an academic community where students learn to think critically, act compassionately and succeed while serving others.  
  
The Villanova community helps students grow intellectually, professionally and spiritually and challenges them to reach their full potential. Villanova’s academic experience, rooted in the liberal arts, forms an environment in which students and professors are partners in learning. Through academic and service programs, students use their skills, knowledge and compassion to better the world around them.  
  
The University draws students from 45 states and nearly 50 countries. More than 10,000 undergraduate, graduate and law students take part in a wide variety of degree and certificate programs throughout the University's six colleges – the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences, the Villanova School of Business, the College of Engineering, the M. Louise Fitzpatrick College of Nursing, the College of Professional Studies and the Villanova University Charles Widger School of Law.  
  
After graduation, students join nearly 125,000 Villanova alumni worldwide.

Marcelo Bengoechea serves as the Creative Director at The Studio at Fernando Bengoechea Photography, where he plays a pivotal role in honoring the legacy of the internationally acclaimed photographer Fernando Bengoechea. With a rich background that blends the creative essence of surfing and the discipline of competitive running, Marcelo brings a unique perspective to the studio's mission of preserving, reviving, and evolving Fernando’s artistic vision. His diverse upbringing across Argentina, Brazil, and Spain, followed by his relocation to San Diego in 1989, has instilled in him a global outlook that enhances his creative endeavors.  
  
In his current role, Marcelo leads key projects that focus on both the artistic and commercial aspects of photography. He employs his expertise in social media marketing, SEO, and online advertising to amplify the studio's presence in the competitive photography landscape. By leveraging market research and user experience principles, he ensures that the studio's offerings resonate with a broad audience while maintaining the authenticity of Fernando's work. Marcelo's commitment to sports marketing is particularly evident in projects that celebrate the intersection of athletics and art, showcasing the dynamic energy of both worlds.  
  
Under his leadership, The Studio at Fernando Bengoechea has not only preserved the stunning imagery left behind by Fernando but has also evolved into a platform that inspires new generations of photographers. In his current role, Marcelo leads key projects that focus on both the artistic and commercial aspects of photography. He employs his expertise in social media marketing, SEO, and online advertising to amplify the studio's presence in the competitive photography landscape. By leveraging market research and user experience principles, he ensures that the studio's offerings resonate with a broad audience while maintaining the authenticity of Fernando's work. Marcelo's commitment to sports marketing is particularly evident in projects that celebrate the intersection of athletics and art, showcasing the dynamic energy of both worlds.  
  
Under his leadership, The Studio at Fernando Bengoechea has not only preserved the stunning imagery left behind by Fernando but has also evolved into a platform that inspires new generations of photographers. Marcelo’s vision is to create a lasting impact in the photography industry, blending innovative marketing strategies with a deep respect for artistic integrity, ensuring that Fernando’s legacy continues to thrive.

About Bristol Myers Squibb
--------------------------

At Bristol Myers Squibb, we work every day to transform patients’ lives through science. That work inspires some of the most interesting, meaningful, and life-changing careers you’ll experience. Join us and pursue innovative ideas alongside some of the brightest minds in biopharma, collaborating with a team rich in diversity of experiences, and perspectives. We have built a sustainable pipeline of potential therapies and are leveraging translational medicine and data analytics to understand how we can deliver the right medicine to the right patient, at the right time, to achieve the best outcome.  
  
Whether in a scientific, business or supporting function, a career at BMS means you’ll be inspired every day to grow and thrive through opportunities that are uncommon in scale and scope. Here, you’ll be on the cutting edge of powerful innovation in oncology, hematology, immunology, cardiovascular disease, and fibrosis, with colleagues united in the mission to help patients.  
  
Through the Bristol Myers Squibb Foundation, we also promote health equity and seek to improve health outcomes of populations disproportionately affected by serious diseases and conditions. Our mission is to give new hope to help patients prevail over serious disease – it drives everything we do.

About Meredith Corporation
--------------------------

Meredith Corporation (NYSE: MDP; meredith.com) has been a leading media company for nearly 120 years, and produces service journalism that engages audiences with essential, inspiring, and trusted content. Meredith reaches consumers where they are across multiple platforms, including digital, video, print, and broadcast television.  
  
Engaging 95 percent of American women across every stage and every day of their lives, Meredith Corporation's National Media Group is home to 40+ iconic brands, including PEOPLE, Better Homes & Gardens, Allrecipes, Southern Living, REAL SIMPLE and Magnolia Journal. The company provides trusted content and experiences that resonate with a massive, highly receptive audience, reaching consumers where they are across digital, magazines, social platforms, video, audio and connected home assistants. Meredith's powerful brands have enabled the company to become the No. 2 licensor globally, including more than 3,500 SKUs of branded products at Walmart. Meredith's businesses also include leading affinity marketer Synapse, award-winning creative content studio Foundry and the Meredith Data Studio.  
  
Meredith’s Local Media Group includes 17 television stations reaching 11 percent of U.S. households. Meredith’s portfolio is concentrated in large, fast-growing markets, with seven stations in the nation’s Top 25 markets—including Atlanta, Phoenix, St. Louis and Portland—and 13 in the Top 50. Meredith’s stations produce more than 700 hours of local news and entertainment content each week and operate leading local digital destinations. Meredith also owns MNI Targeted Media, which delivers targeted advertising solutions to more than 1,200 clients on a local, regional or national level.

Belief. Beer & Friendship.  
  
For the three close friends behind Last Man Standing, it is more than simply a desire to make a great beverage – it is a project of passion that is the embodiment of a genuine love of beer, great mates and an overwhelming drive to help support and inspire others.  
  
Appreciating the real value of mateship and the support it brought to their lives in the best and toughest times, two brothers and an unlikely Australian sporting legend, have created Last Man Standing to inspire others, through their version of Australia’s favourite drink. About Little, Brown and Company
-------------------------------

Little, Brown and Company was founded in 1837 and for close to two centuries has published fiction and nonfiction by many of America's finest writers. Early lists featured Little Women by Louisa May Alcott, Emily Dickinson's poetry, and Bartlett's Familiar Quotations, all of which are still available today. In 1993 Little, Brown created a new trade paperback imprint, Back Bay Books, to focus on long-term publication of the company's best fiction and nonfiction and to publish original trade paperbacks. Little, Brown is also the home of Bulfinch Press, a leading publisher of art and photography books. Bestselling novelists on our Little, Brown hardcover and Back Bay paperback lists include J. D. Salinger, James Patterson, Herman Wouk, Alice Sebold, Anita Shreve, Walter Mosley, Janet Fitch, John le Carre, Jimmy Buffett, Pete Hamill, David Foster Wallace, and Michael Connelly. In nonfiction, Little, Brown's bestselling and prizewinning works include such distinguished writers as Nelson Mandela, James Bradley, William Manchester, George Stephanopoulos, Gloria Steinem, the Dalai Lama, David Sedaris, John Feinstein, Malcolm Gladwell, and the cartoonist R. Crumb. Bulfinch publishes the distinguished photography of Ansel Adams, Sally Mann, Irving Penn, Henri Cartier-Bresson, Timothy Greenfield-Sanders, Joyce Tenneson, Howard Schatz and Abelardo Morell.

What services does Haymarket offer for digital content marketing?

Haymarket offers a comprehensive suite of digital content marketing services designed to enhance brand visibility and engagement. These services include content strategy development, digital media campaigns, SEO optimization, and social media management. Haymarket takes a strategic approach to content development by first understanding the client's goals, target audience, and market landscape. The strategy encompasses content creation, distribution, and performance measurement, allowing clients to achieve their marketing objectives effectively.

Trader Joe’s is a national chain of neighborhood grocery stores. We are committed to providing our customers outstanding value in the form of the best quality products at the best everyday prices. Our customizable enterprise solutions include interpretation, translation, multilingual and technical staffing, multilingual contact centers with business process outsourcing capabilities, learning, and localization services.

What types of translation services does Akorbi offer?

Akorbi provides a wide range of translation services, including document translation, website localization, and machine translation post-editing. Our team of professional linguists is skilled in various industries, ensuring that your content is accurately translated while maintaining cultural relevance and context.

How does Akorbi support companies with multilingual staffing?

Akorbi specializes in multilingual staffing solutions to help companies find qualified candidates who can communicate effectively in multiple languages. We assess the specific language needs of your organization and leverage our extensive network to connect you with professionals who possess the necessary language skills and industry expertise.

What industries does Akorbi serve?

Akorbi serves a diverse range of industries, including healthcare, technology, finance, legal, and education. Our tailored solutions are designed to meet the unique needs of each sector, ensuring that our clients receive the highest quality services that align with their industry standards and regulations.

Can Akorbi assist with video mobility and interpretation services?

Yes, Akorbi offers video mobility and interpretation services to facilitate real-time communication across different languages. Our interpreters are trained in various modalities, including video remote interpreting (VRI) and over-the-phone interpreting (OPI), allowing organizations to connect with clients and partners globally, regardless of location.

What is the process for website localization at Akorbi?

The website localization process at Akorbi involves several key steps: initial assessment of your website's content and target audience, translation of text and adaptation of visuals, cultural customization to ensure relevance, and rigorous quality assurance testing. Our clean, efficient, modern and flexible fleet uses advanced technologies to generate power in a low-carbon and environmentally responsible manner. We are uniquely positioned to benefit from the secular trends affecting our industry, including the abundant and affordable supply of clean natural gas, environmental regulation, aging power generation infrastructure and the increasing need for dispatchable power plants to successfully integrate intermittent renewables into the grid. Please visit www.calpine.com to learn more about how Calpine is creating power for a sustainable future.

The mission of the Tennessee College of Applied Technology is to continue to serve as the premier provider for workforce development throughout the State of Tennessee. The Tennessee College of Applied Technology is accredited by the Commission of the Council on Occupational Education.

About Terry Luttrell

Terry Luttrell is an American singer and musician best known for his soulful vocals and powerful stage presence. With a career spanning over five decades, Luttrell has made a name for himself as one of the most versatile and dynamic voices in the music industry. From his early days as the lead singer of the legendary rock band REO Speedwagon to his solo work, Luttrell has captivated audiences with his raw talent and undeniable passion for music.  
  
Born and raised in Champaign, Illinois, Luttrell found his love for music at a young age. Influenced by the likes of Otis Redding, James Brown, and Ray Charles, Luttrell developed a deep appreciation for soul and R&B music, which would later shape his own musical style. In the late 1960s, Luttrell joined forces with fellow musicians in the local music scene and formed the band REO Speedwagon. As the lead vocalist, Luttrell's powerful voice and charismatic stage presence quickly gained attention, and the band began to gain traction in the music industry.  
  
With REO Speedwagon, Luttrell recorded several albums and toured extensively, gaining a loyal fan base and earning a reputation for their electrifying live performances. Their breakthrough album, "Ridin' the Storm Out," featured Luttrell's soulful vocals on the title track, which became a fan favorite and solidified his status as a rising star in the rock music scene. However, Luttrell's time with REO Speedwagon was short-lived, as he ultimately decided to part ways with the band to pursue a solo career and explore new opportunities in music.  
  
After leaving REO Speedwagon, Luttrell continued to pursue his passion for music and embarked on a solo career that showcased his versatility as a singer and songwriter. His solo work drew upon his love for soul and R&B, incorporating elements of blues, funk, and rock to create a unique sound that resonated with audiences. Luttrell's performances were characterized by his powerful vocals and dynamic stage presence, leaving a lasting impression on anyone who had the pleasure of seeing him perform live.  
  
Luttrell's solo albums, including "You're My Woman" and "Terry Luttrell," received critical acclaim and further established him as a formidable talent in the music industry. His ability to convey emotion and storytelling through his music resonated with fans and solidified his reputation as a true artist. Air Force Special Operations Command was established May 22, 1990, with headquarters at Hurlburt Field, Fla. AFSOC is one of 10 major Air Force commands, and the Air Force component of U.S. Special Operations Command, a unified command located at MacDill Air Force Base, Fla.  
  
AFSOC provides Air Force special operations forces for worldwide deployment and assignment to regional unified commands. The command's SOF are composed of highly trained, rapidly deployable Airmen, conducting global special operations missions ranging from precision application of firepower to infiltration, exfiltration, resupply and refueling of SOF operational elements.  
  
The command's core missions include battlefield air operations, agile combat support, aviation foreign internal defense, information operations/military support operations, precision strike, specialized air mobility; command and control; and intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance.  
  
AFSOC's unique capabilities include airborne radio and television broadcast for psychological operations, as well as aviation foreign internal defense instructors to provide other governments military expertise for their internal development. The command's special tactics squadrons combine combat controllers, tactical air control party members, special operations weathermen and pararescuemen with other service SOF to form versatile joint special operations teams.

About Christy Turlington

Christy Turlington is an iconic American fashion model who has cemented her place in the industry as one of the most recognizable and revered faces of all time. With her captivating beauty, poise, and timeless appeal, she has graced countless runways, magazine covers, and campaigns, becoming a true icon in the world of high fashion.  
  
Born on January 2, 1969, in Walnut Creek, California, Christy Turlington was discovered at the tender age of 14 by a local photographer. She quickly caught the attention of industry insiders with her striking looks and natural talent. With her caramel-toned skin, lustrous brown hair, and piercing brown eyes, Turlington possessed a unique beauty that stood out from the rest.  
  
In 1987, Turlington's rise to stardom began when she signed her first major modeling contract with the renowned agency, Ford Models. Her career took off instantly, and she made her first appearance on the cover of American Vogue that same year. From that moment on, Turlington's star seemed to shine brighter with each passing year.  
  
Turlington gained worldwide recognition as the face of Calvin Klein's Eternity fragrance campaign in the late 1980s. The ad, featuring Turlington with her ethereal beauty, created a sensation and remains an iconic symbol of love and romance to this day. This campaign propelled her to international stardom, and she became a highly sought-after model for luxury brands such as Chanel, Versace, Prada, and Gucci.  
  
Beyond her modeling career, Turlington has become a symbol of strength and advocacy. She has used her platform to raise awareness about maternal health and promote women's rights around the world. Turlington's personal experience with complications during childbirth led her to co-found the nonprofit organization Every Mother Counts in 2010. The organization works towards ensuring that every woman has access to quality maternal healthcare, reducing preventable deaths during childbirth by providing essential resources and essential knowledge.  
  
Turlington's dedication to her philanthropic work is truly remarkable. She has tirelessly traveled to various countries like Bangladesh, Tanzania, and Guatemala to witness firsthand the challenges faced by women and to advocate for their rights. Her activism has greatly contributed to improving maternal health globally, and she continues to be a strong voice for women's empowerment.  
  
Despite her longstanding success, Turlington has never lost touch with her roots. Alongside her philanthropic endeavors, she continues to grace the covers of top magazines, walk the runway for renowned fashion houses, and star in high-profile campaigns. Her ability to effortlessly connect with the camera and bring garments to life is a testament to her enduring appeal and versatility as a model.  
  
Turlington's magnetic presence and enduring influence have created a lasting impact in the fashion industry. Her natural elegance, coupled with her dedication to philanthropy, has set her apart, making her a true legend in her field. An inspiration to aspiring models and women around the world, Christy Turlington's legacy goes beyond the runways - she is a shining example of grace, strength, and the power of using one's voice for positive change.

About Christy Turlington

Christy Turlington is an iconic American fashion model who has cemented her place in the industry as one of the most recognizable and revered faces of all time. With her captivating beauty, poise, and timeless appeal, she has graced countless runways, magazine covers, and campaigns, becoming a true icon in the world of high fashion.  
  
Born on January 2, 1969, in Walnut Creek, California, Christy Turlington was discovered at the tender age of 14 by a local photographer. She quickly caught the attention of industry insiders with her striking looks and natural talent. With her caramel-toned skin, lustrous brown hair, and piercing brown eyes, Turlington possessed a unique beauty that stood out from the rest.  
  
In 1987, Turlington's rise to stardom began when she signed her first major modeling contract with the renowned agency, Ford Models. Her career took off instantly, and she made her first appearance on the cover of American Vogue that same year. From that moment on, Turlington's star seemed to shine brighter with each passing year.  
  
Turlington gained worldwide recognition as the face of Calvin Klein's Eternity fragrance campaign in the late 1980s. The ad, featuring Turlington with her ethereal beauty, created a sensation and remains an iconic symbol of love and romance to this day. This campaign propelled her to international stardom, and she became a highly sought-after model for luxury brands such as Chanel, Versace, Prada, and Gucci.  
  
Beyond her modeling career, Turlington has become a symbol of strength and advocacy. She has used her platform to raise awareness about maternal health and promote women's rights around the world. Turlington's personal experience with complications during childbirth led her to co-found the nonprofit organization Every Mother Counts in 2010. The organization works towards ensuring that every woman has access to quality maternal healthcare, reducing preventable deaths during childbirth by providing essential resources and essential knowledge.  
  
Turlington's dedication to her philanthropic work is truly remarkable. She has tirelessly traveled to various countries like Bangladesh, Tanzania, and Guatemala to witness firsthand the challenges faced by women and to advocate for their rights. Her activism has greatly contributed to improving maternal health globally, and she continues to be a strong voice for women's empowerment.  
  
Despite her longstanding success, Turlington has never lost touch with her roots. Alongside her philanthropic endeavors, she continues to grace the covers of top magazines, walk the runway for renowned fashion houses, and star in high-profile campaigns. Her ability to effortlessly connect with the camera and bring garments to life is a testament to her enduring appeal and versatility as a model.  
  
Turlington's magnetic presence and enduring influence have created a lasting impact in the fashion industry. Her natural elegance, coupled with her dedication to philanthropy, has set her apart, making her a true legend in her field. An inspiration to aspiring models and women around the world, Christy Turlington's legacy goes beyond the runways - she is a shining example of grace, strength, and the power of using one's voice for positive change.

About The Roberts Group
-----------------------

The Roberts Group began operations in 1999. Since the birth of the Company, the emphasis has been on the development of theatrical-based Subscription Series in secondary markets.  
  
TRG currently operates Subscription Series in Columbia, SC; Daytona Beach, FL; Wheeling, WV; and Newport News, VA. TRG has a vast history of presenting touring theatrical events in markets of all shapes and sizes including such titles as Wicked, The Book of Mormon, Cats, The Illusionists, Miss Saigon, Chicago, Jersey Boys, Les Miserables, Mamma Mia!, Blue Man Group, Michael Flatley’s Lord of The Dance, Cabaret, The Producers, Rent, Annie, Disney’s Beauty and the Beast, Mannheim Steamroller’s Christmas, Riverdance and Stomp among many others.  
  
TRG has strong, long-standing relationships with key booking agencies in New York, Los Angeles, and Nashville. In addition to operating Subscription Series, TRG also has a long history of presenting non-theatrical programming including musical artists such as Johnny Mathis, Ann Murray, Kenny Rogers, Frankie Valli, and The Oak Ridge Boys. Other special events include David Copperfield, The Price is Right Live, Celtic Woman, Walking with Dinosaurs, Wild Kratts LIVE, Daniel Tiger’s Neighborhood LIVE, Alton Brown, David Sedaris, and Neil deGrasse Tyson, as well as other complimentary programming.  
  
TRG continues to expand its operations into the coming years forging new relationships and expanding its current artist roster targeting those artists that would be appropriate for proscenium theatre settings.

American Advisors Group (AAG Reverse Mortgage)
==============================================

[Get verified emails for American Advisors Group (AAG Reverse Mortgage) employees\
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------](javascript:;)

*   [Profile](https://contactout.com/company/American-Advisors-Group-AAG-Reverse-Mortgage-47469)

About American Advisors Group (AAG Reverse Mortgage)
----------------------------------------------------

American Advisors Group is a lender in the reverse mortgage industry. The company is licensed in 48 states. Located in Orange, CA, there is also an additional retail office in Kennesaw Georgia as well as the wholesale division located in Scottsdale Arizona. The company was founded in 2004 by Reza Jahangiri. Now President and CEO, Jahangiri has expanded the company exponentially in the past decade with offerings beyond reverse mortgages. CEO Jahangiri is also a founding board member in the Coalition of Independent Seniors (CIS) and served as CEO of several healthcare providers prior to his work with American Advisors Group. His background in the industry has led to his success with AAG. In 2014, Jahangiri was announced as a semi-finalist for the Ernst & Young Entrepreneur of the Year Award. Since 2010, the company has grown from just 60 employees to more than 750. Of those new additions, more than 200 workers joined between 2012 and 2013. AAG has recently acquired two companies to further add to its expansion: Reverse Mortgage USA, a smaller reverse mortgage company, as well as Associated Mortgage Banker’s Reverse Division. American Advisors Group provides home equity conversion mortgage (HECM) loans and has 81 HUD approved areas of business. Today, the company is ranked among the top reverse mortgage lenders in the country and has been the #1 lender for HECM Retail since July 2013. The AAG Reverse Mortgage team differs from others in the market due to their unique internal structure. The company operates on a direct-to-consumer, centralized model. Management and staff is all under one roof, which keeps the business agile and allows for spur-of-the-moment training in spite of the company’s large size. AAG offers substantial benefits to company employees including a 401K matching program and work-life balance policies. New Loan Officers go through a rigorous 6 week paid training program and are guided by the AAG Training Department team. Countless “AAG University” online courses are also available to all employees. In 2010, former senator Fred Thompson signed on as the spokesperson for American Advisors Group. Having seen numerous commercials and television advertisements featuring the politician, many Americans today associate his face with the reverse mortgage industry. Prior to Fred Thompson, American Advisors Group was represented by actor Peter Graves. In 2009, he served as the face of the company in a comprehensive marketing campaign touting the benefits of reverse mortgages for seniors. Aside from reverse mortgages, AAG participates in the non-profit space. In 2011, Jahangiri created the “AAG Gives Back Committee” to contribute to charitable organizations around the globe. Though initially AAG was dedicated solely to the Kwagala Project, they have since expanded to domestic charities including Alzheimer’s Association, Harvest Food Bank, Families Forward, and Friends & Helpers. The company is very active in fundraising events, sponsoring several fun activities for employee participation to encourage donations. Most recently, AAG held a company-wide Spelling Bee, sparking employees’ competitive natures and thus raising over $1100 dollars for low-income-seniors, which is the highest fundraising amount to date. In 2012, AAG’s CEO Reza Jahangiri took over The Reverse Review, a magazine devoted to the reverse mortgage market. This acquisition allows for a seamless exchange of industry information and increases the availability and quality of home equity conversion mortgage loan products. For Americans with questions about how to obtain an AAG reverse mortgage, The Reverse Review is one of the leading sources informational materials. The company’s mission states that employees should strive to make the reverse mortgage experience as informative and efficient as possible, in order to serve the senior community with the highest level of satisfaction. In September 2012, AAG’s dedicated sales team and management were rewarded for their efforts. Reverse Mortgage Daily awarded American Advisors Group three industry awards: Best Retail Brand Best Lead Provider Best Celebrity Spokesperson The RMD Awards are based on more than 45,000 votes from contributors across various sectors of the reverse mortgage industry. Since then, the company has only continued to grow and accumulate positive press. In 2014, the AAG Digital Marketing department completed an overhaul of the company’s entire website, taking into consideration opinions and comments of their senior demographic and making the new site easier to navigate as well as more aesthetically pleasing. The first consumer newsletter, The Monthly Line, was also launched, containing a variety of content from heartwarming borrower stories to entertaining puzzles, in order to appeal to its target audience. American Advisors Group has an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau and was recently ranked #3 as a Top Workplace in Orange, CA by the Orange County Register. In addition, AAG continues to maintain a 97% Customer Satisfaction Rating in customer surveys. The company is also an active member in the National Reverse Mortgage Lenders Association (NRMLA). Also, AAG is one of the finalists for the ACG Awards for Corporate Growth, which is an award that honors a local company that demonstrates growth in employment, profitability, charity and sales.

About American Advisors Group (AAG Reverse Mortgage)
----------------------------------------------------

American Advisors Group is a lender in the reverse mortgage industry. The company is licensed in 48 states. Located in Orange, CA, there is also an additional retail office in Kennesaw Georgia as well as the wholesale division located in Scottsdale Arizona. The company was founded in 2004 by Reza Jahangiri. Now President and CEO, Jahangiri has expanded the company exponentially in the past decade with offerings beyond reverse mortgages. CEO Jahangiri is also a founding board member in the Coalition of Independent Seniors (CIS) and served as CEO of several healthcare providers prior to his work with American Advisors Group. His background in the industry has led to his success with AAG. In 2014, Jahangiri was announced as a semi-finalist for the Ernst & Young Entrepreneur of the Year Award. Since 2010, the company has grown from just 60 employees to more than 750. Of those new additions, more than 200 workers joined between 2012 and 2013. AAG has recently acquired two companies to further add to its expansion: Reverse Mortgage USA, a smaller reverse mortgage company, as well as Associated Mortgage Banker’s Reverse Division. American Advisors Group provides home equity conversion mortgage (HECM) loans and has 81 HUD approved areas of business. Today, the company is ranked among the top reverse mortgage lenders in the country and has been the #1 lender for HECM Retail since July 2013. The AAG Reverse Mortgage team differs from others in the market due to their unique internal structure. The company operates on a direct-to-consumer, centralized model. Management and staff is all under one roof, which keeps the business agile and allows for spur-of-the-moment training in spite of the company’s large size. AAG offers substantial benefits to company employees including a 401K matching program and work-life balance policies. New Loan Officers go through a rigorous 6 week paid training program and are guided by the AAG Training Department team. Countless “AAG University” online courses are also available to all employees. In 2010, former senator Fred Thompson signed on as the spokesperson for American Advisors Group. Having seen numerous commercials and television advertisements featuring the politician, many Americans today associate his face with the reverse mortgage industry. Prior to Fred Thompson, American Advisors Group was represented by actor Peter Graves. In 2009, he served as the face of the company in a comprehensive marketing campaign touting the benefits of reverse mortgages for seniors. Aside from reverse mortgages, AAG participates in the non-profit space. In 2011, Jahangiri created the “AAG Gives Back Committee” to contribute to charitable organizations around the globe. Though initially AAG was dedicated solely to the Kwagala Project, they have since expanded to domestic charities including Alzheimer’s Association, Harvest Food Bank, Families Forward, and Friends & Helpers. The company is very active in fundraising events, sponsoring several fun activities for employee participation to encourage donations. Most recently, AAG held a company-wide Spelling Bee, sparking employees’ competitive natures and thus raising over $1100 dollars for low-income-seniors, which is the highest fundraising amount to date. In 2012, AAG’s CEO Reza Jahangiri took over The Reverse Review, a magazine devoted to the reverse mortgage market. This acquisition allows for a seamless exchange of industry information and increases the availability and quality of home equity conversion mortgage loan products. For Americans with questions about how to obtain an AAG reverse mortgage, The Reverse Review is one of the leading sources informational materials. The company’s mission states that employees should strive to make the reverse mortgage experience as informative and efficient as possible, in order to serve the senior community with the highest level of satisfaction. In September 2012, AAG’s dedicated sales team and management were rewarded for their efforts. Reverse Mortgage Daily awarded American Advisors Group three industry awards: Best Retail Brand Best Lead Provider Best Celebrity Spokesperson The RMD Awards are based on more than 45,000 votes from contributors across various sectors of the reverse mortgage industry. Since then, the company has only continued to grow and accumulate positive press. In 2014, the AAG Digital Marketing department completed an overhaul of the company’s entire website, taking into consideration opinions and comments of their senior demographic and making the new site easier to navigate as well as more aesthetically pleasing. The first consumer newsletter, The Monthly Line, was also launched, containing a variety of content from heartwarming borrower stories to entertaining puzzles, in order to appeal to its target audience. American Advisors Group has an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau and was recently ranked #3 as a Top Workplace in Orange, CA by the Orange County Register. In addition, AAG continues to maintain a 97% Customer Satisfaction Rating in customer surveys. The company is also an active member in the National Reverse Mortgage Lenders Association (NRMLA). Also, AAG is one of the finalists for the ACG Awards for Corporate Growth, which is an award that honors a local company that demonstrates growth in employment, profitability, charity and sales.

About Tampa's Lowry Park Zoo
----------------------------

If fun is in your nature, spend some time at Tampa's Lowry Park Zoo, named the #1 Zoo in the U.S. by both Parents and Child magazines! The Zoo features more than 1,500 incredible animals on nearly 60 lush acres including koalas, elephants, tigers, penguins, chimpanzees, orangutans and much more. Have a wild time feeding a giraffe, holding a lorikeet, touching a stingray, walking with wallabies, encountering a white rhino and more. The Zoo's Manatee and Aquatic Center expands the traditional boundaries of a zoo, focusing efforts on critical care for injured, sick and orphaned Florida manatees. It is one of the only places that you can see these gentle giants year-round. During your visit, keep cool in the warm Florida sun with water play areas, wild rides, shows, shopping and restaurants. Don’t miss the adorable new additions to the Zoo including a baby African elephant, baby pygmy hippo, orphaned Florida black bear cubs and more!  
  
Tampa's Lowry Park Zoological Society, in agreement with the City of Tampa, operates Tampa's Lowry Park Zoo as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit charitable organization.

About St Cuthberts Care
-----------------------

St Cuthbert's Care is committed to helping improve the lives of some of the most vulnerable members of our communities, including people with profound disabilities, children in care, older people and those living on the margins of society. Firmly rooted in the Catholic faith, our charity always has and always will place people at the heart of its work.  
Our work is highly specialised and we often work in areas of high need that are either unattractive or considered to be too high risk for other providers to take on. To fulfil our Purpose, we engage and contract with a range of professional bodies and local authorities and work closely with churches, other charities and not-for-profit organisations as well as local communities.  
We are a Living Wage employer – the first regional charity in the North East, delivering adult social care as part of their work, to be accredited by the Living Wage Foundation.

About MAP International
-----------------------

MAP International is a Christian organization providing life-changing medicines and health supplies to people in need. MAP serves all people, regardless of religion, gender, race, nationality or ethnic background.  
  
We provide medicines and health supplies to those in need around the world so they might experience life to the fullest. In times of disaster, MAP International provides immediate humanitarian assistance and relief aid including medicines and health supplies to people left homeless and without access to basic services. From the earliest days of a response, MAP focuses on helping communities restore critical services and work with partners to help them rebuild health systems.  
  
MAP International has provided more than $6 billion in medicines and health supplies to communities in need since its inception in 1954. MAP is recognized for its stewardship by charity watchdogs, each year achieving the highest ratings from Guidestar, the Better Business Bureau, CharityWatch, CNBC, ECFA and Forbes magazine.

About MAP International
-----------------------

MAP International is a Christian organization providing life-changing medicines and health supplies to people in need. MAP serves all people, regardless of religion, gender, race, nationality or ethnic background.  
  
We provide medicines and health supplies to those in need around the world so they might experience life to the fullest. In times of disaster, MAP International provides immediate humanitarian assistance and relief aid including medicines and health supplies to people left homeless and without access to basic services. From the earliest days of a response, MAP focuses on helping communities restore critical services and work with partners to help them rebuild health systems.  
  
MAP International has provided more than $6 billion in medicines and health supplies to communities in need since its inception in 1954. MAP is recognized for its stewardship by charity watchdogs, each year achieving the highest ratings from Guidestar, the Better Business Bureau, CharityWatch, CNBC, ECFA and Forbes magazine.

We are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization offering assistance, shelter, and hope in greater Dayton. Our mission is to, with Christian purpose, accompany those in need one person at a time by focusing on shelter, food, and clothing. Our vision is to improve the lives of people in need in the Miami Valley. We aid those struggling with homelessness and poverty by providing emergency shelter, supportive housing, food, clothing and household items, and guidance on the path to leading a self-sustaining life. We provide help to individuals and families who are on the brink of losing their housing, those who are currently homeless, and those working to secure and maintain permanent housing. What types of assistance does St. Vincent de Paul Dayton provide?

St. Vincent de Paul Dayton offers a variety of assistance programs aimed at helping individuals and families in need. How can I access emergency assistance from St. Vincent de Paul Dayton?

What services are available at the St. Vincent de Paul Dayton Thrift Store?

The St. Vincent de Paul Dayton Thrift Store offers a wide range of gently used clothing, household items, and furniture at affordable prices. Proceeds from the store directly support our programs and services for those in need. Additionally, we welcome donations of items in good condition, which can be dropped off at the store or arranged for pickup through our donation services.

How can I volunteer with St. Vincent de Paul Dayton?

Volunteering with St. Vincent de Paul Dayton is a rewarding way to give back to the community. What is the process for donating a vehicle to St. Vincent de Paul Dayton?

Donating a vehicle to St. Vincent de Paul Dayton is a straightforward process. You can fill out a vehicle donation form on our website, and our team will contact you to arrange for pickup. Donated vehicles are sold, and the proceeds help fund our programs and services. Plus, you may be eligible for a tax deduction for your generous contribution.

What types of events does St. Vincent de Paul Dayton host?

St. Vincent de Paul Dayton hosts a variety of events throughout the year to raise awareness and support for our mission. About St. Vincent de Paul Dayton
--------------------------------

We are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization offering assistance, shelter, and hope in greater Dayton. Our mission is to, with Christian purpose, accompany those in need one person at a time by focusing on shelter, food, and clothing. Our vision is to improve the lives of people in need in the Miami Valley. We aid those struggling with homelessness and poverty by providing emergency shelter, supportive housing, food, clothing and household items, and guidance on the path to leading a self-sustaining life. We provide help to individuals and families who are on the brink of losing their housing, those who are currently homeless, and those working to secure and maintain permanent housing. Contact us today for help or to support our mission.

Who are the decision makers in St. Vincent de Paul Dayton?

What types of assistance does St. Vincent de Paul Dayton provide?

St. Vincent de Paul Dayton offers a variety of assistance programs aimed at helping individuals and families in need. These include emergency assistance for basic needs, housing support, food pantry services, financial assistance, and counseling. We also provide shelter for the homeless, supportive housing options, and volunteer opportunities for those looking to give back to the community.

How can I access emergency assistance from St. Vincent de Paul Dayton?

To access emergency assistance, individuals can contact our office directly or visit our website for more information. We typically require some basic information about your situation to determine eligibility. Our team is dedicated to providing support and will guide you through the process to ensure you receive the help you need.

What services are available at the St. Vincent de Paul Dayton Thrift Store?

The St. Vincent de Paul Dayton Thrift Store offers a wide range of gently used clothing, household items, and furniture at affordable prices. Proceeds from the store directly support our programs and services for those in need. Additionally, we welcome donations of items in good condition, which can be dropped off at the store or arranged for pickup through our donation services.

How can I volunteer with St. Vincent de Paul Dayton?

Volunteering with St. Vincent de Paul Dayton is a rewarding way to give back to the community. We offer various volunteer opportunities, including working in our thrift store, assisting in the food pantry, and helping with events. Interested individuals can fill out a volunteer application on our website or contact our volunteer coordinator for more information on how to get involved.

What is the process for donating a vehicle to St. Vincent de Paul Dayton?

Donating a vehicle to St. Vincent de Paul Dayton is a straightforward process. You can fill out a vehicle donation form on our website, and our team will contact you to arrange for pickup. Donated vehicles are sold, and the proceeds help fund our programs and services. Plus, you may be eligible for a tax deduction for your generous contribution.

What types of events does St. Vincent de Paul Dayton host?

St. Vincent de Paul Dayton hosts a variety of events throughout the year to raise awareness and support for our mission. These include fundraising events, community outreach programs, and volunteer appreciation gatherings. We also participate in local events to connect with the community and share information about our services. Check our website for upcoming events and how you can participate.

From ballet to Broadway, comedy to popular music shows, you’re always in for an amazing experience – here at the arts center.

Donors

Name A Seat

What types of degree programs does Regent University offer?

Regent University offers a wide range of degree programs across various disciplines, including undergraduate and graduate degrees in fields such as Law, Government, Psychology, Communication, Leadership, Education, Counseling, Business, Theology, and Divinity. Both on-campus and online options are available, allowing students to choose the format that best fits their lifestyle and learning preferences.

Is Regent University accredited?

Yes, Regent University is accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC) to award associate, baccalaureate, master's, and doctoral degrees. Additionally, specific programs, such as the School of Law and the School of Education, hold specialized accreditations, ensuring that the university meets high academic standards.

What support services are available for online students?

Regent University provides a variety of support services for online students, including academic advising, technical support, library resources, and access to tutoring services. Students can also participate in virtual study groups and connect with faculty through online office hours, ensuring they receive the guidance and assistance needed to succeed in their studies.

How does Regent University integrate Christian values into its curriculum?

Regent University is committed to integrating Christian values into its curriculum across all programs. This is achieved through a focus on ethical decision-making, servant leadership, and a worldview that emphasizes the importance of faith in both personal and professional contexts. Students are encouraged to explore the intersection of their faith and their chosen field of study.

What career services does Regent University offer to students and alumni?

Regent University offers comprehensive career services to both current students and alumni, including resume writing assistance, interview preparation, job search strategies, and networking opportunities. The university also hosts career fairs and workshops, connecting students with potential employers and helping them navigate the job market effectively.

Can I transfer credits from another institution to Regent University?

Yes, Regent University accepts transfer credits from accredited institutions. The transfer process involves an evaluation of previously earned credits to determine their applicability to your chosen program at Regent. Students are encouraged to submit official transcripts and consult with an academic advisor to understand how their credits can be applied toward their degree.

What types of diseases does Shire focus on in its orphan drug development?

Shire specializes in developing treatments for rare diseases, particularly those that affect small patient populations. This includes conditions such as genetic disorders, metabolic diseases, and other serious health issues that often lack effective treatment options. The company is committed to addressing the unmet medical needs of patients suffering from these rare conditions.

How does Shire support patients and families affected by rare diseases?

Shire provides comprehensive support to patients and their families through various initiatives, including patient assistance programs, educational resources, and advocacy efforts. These programs aim to help patients access necessary treatments, navigate healthcare systems, and connect with support networks. Shire also collaborates with patient advocacy organizations to raise awareness and improve the overall quality of care for those affected by rare diseases.

What is the process for a drug to be classified as an orphan drug by Shire?

To be classified as an orphan drug, a treatment must be intended for a rare disease that affects fewer than 200,000 people in the United States, or for which there is no reasonable expectation that the cost of development will be recovered from sales. Shire follows regulatory guidelines set by agencies such as the FDA and EMA, which provide incentives for the development of orphan drugs, including tax credits, grants, and market exclusivity.

What industries does Shire collaborate with to enhance its drug development efforts?

Shire collaborates with various industries, including biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and academic institutions, to enhance its drug development efforts. These collaborations may involve research partnerships, clinical trials, and sharing of expertise to accelerate the development of innovative therapies for rare diseases. By leveraging the strengths of different sectors, Shire aims to bring effective treatments to market more efficiently.

How can healthcare professionals stay informed about Shire's latest developments and products?

Healthcare professionals can stay informed about Shire's latest developments and products through several channels, including the company's official website, medical conferences, and professional journals. Shire also provides resources such as newsletters and webinars to keep healthcare providers updated on new research findings, product launches, and treatment guidelines related to rare diseases.

What role does patient feedback play in Shire's drug development process?

Patient feedback is a crucial component of Shire's drug development process. The company actively seeks input from patients and caregivers to understand their experiences, needs, and treatment preferences. This feedback helps inform clinical trial design, product development, and post-marketing strategies, ensuring that the therapies developed are aligned with the real-world needs of patients. Shire is committed to incorporating the patient voice into every stage of the drug development process.

What types of diseases does Shire focus on in its orphan drug development?

Shire specializes in developing treatments for rare diseases, particularly those that affect small patient populations. This includes conditions such as genetic disorders, metabolic diseases, and other serious health issues that often lack effective treatment options. The company is committed to addressing the unmet medical needs of patients suffering from these rare conditions.

How does Shire support patients and families affected by rare diseases?

Shire provides comprehensive support to patients and their families through various initiatives, including patient assistance programs, educational resources, and advocacy efforts. These programs aim to help patients access necessary treatments, navigate healthcare systems, and connect with support networks. Shire also collaborates with patient advocacy organizations to raise awareness and improve the overall quality of care for those affected by rare diseases.

What is the process for a drug to be classified as an orphan drug by Shire?

To be classified as an orphan drug, a treatment must be intended for a rare disease that affects fewer than 200,000 people in the United States, or for which there is no reasonable expectation that the cost of development will be recovered from sales. Shire follows regulatory guidelines set by agencies such as the FDA and EMA, which provide incentives for the development of orphan drugs, including tax credits, grants, and market exclusivity.

What industries does Shire collaborate with to enhance its drug development efforts?

Shire collaborates with various industries, including biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and academic institutions, to enhance its drug development efforts. These collaborations may involve research partnerships, clinical trials, and sharing of expertise to accelerate the development of innovative therapies for rare diseases. By leveraging the strengths of different sectors, Shire aims to bring effective treatments to market more efficiently.

How can healthcare professionals stay informed about Shire's latest developments and products?

Healthcare professionals can stay informed about Shire's latest developments and products through several channels, including the company's official website, medical conferences, and professional journals. Shire also provides resources such as newsletters and webinars to keep healthcare providers updated on new research findings, product launches, and treatment guidelines related to rare diseases.

What role does patient feedback play in Shire's drug development process?

Patient feedback is a crucial component of Shire's drug development process. The company actively seeks input from patients and caregivers to understand their experiences, needs, and treatment preferences. This feedback helps inform clinical trial design, product development, and post-marketing strategies, ensuring that the therapies developed are aligned with the real-world needs of patients. Shire is committed to incorporating the patient voice into every stage of the drug development process.

What programs does Girl Scouts of Western Washington offer for youth leadership development?

Girl Scouts of Western Washington offers a variety of programs designed to foster youth leadership skills. Girls engage in activities that promote decision-making, teamwork, and public speaking, all aimed at empowering them to take on leadership roles in their communities.

How does Girl Scouts of Western Washington support STEM education for girls?

Girl Scouts of Western Washington is committed to promoting STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) education among girls. Our programs often include coding, robotics, environmental science, and engineering challenges, all designed to spark interest and build confidence in STEM subjects.

What age groups does Girl Scouts of Western Washington serve?

About Qingdao University
------------------------

Qingdao University, located in the picturesque coastal city of Qingdao, Shandong Province, boasts a rich history and a vibrant academic environment. Established in 1924 as a private institution, it has evolved through various phases, including its time as National Qingdao University and National Shandong University. The university is renowned for its distinguished faculty, which has included prominent educators and scholars such as Yang Zhensheng, Zhao Taimou, and poets like Zang Kejia. Today, Qingdao University is home to 22 colleges offering a wide array of programs, including 86 undergraduate majors, 156 master's programs, and 27 doctoral programs across diverse disciplines such as literature, science, engineering, medicine, and management.  
  
With over 38,000 full-time students, including more than 31,000 undergraduates and nearly 1,000 international students, Qingdao University fosters a dynamic learning atmosphere. The faculty comprises approximately 2,300 dedicated teachers, including 965 professors and associate professors, alongside over 60 foreign experts who contribute to the university's global perspective. The institution is recognized for its academic excellence, featuring two national key disciplines and 26 provincial key disciplines, as well as numerous research centers and laboratories.  
  
Qingdao University continues to build on its strong educational traditions while embracing modern advancements, making it a leading institution in China. For those interested in exploring the faculty, a comprehensive Qingdao University teachers list is available, showcasing the diverse expertise and qualifications of its educators. As Qingdao University moves forward, it remains committed to fostering innovation and academic excellence in a supportive and culturally rich environment.

About SeaWorld Parks & Entertainment
------------------------------------

SeaWorld Parks & Entertainment™ is a leading theme park and entertainment company providing experiences that matter and inspiring guests to protect animals and the wild wonders of our world. We are one of the world’s foremost zoological organizations and a global leader in animal husbandry, behavioral management, veterinary care and animal welfare. We also rescue and rehabilitate marine and terrestrial animals that are ill, injured, orphaned or abandoned, with the goal of returning them to the wild. The SeaWorld® and Busch Gardens® rescue teams have helped more than 40,000 animals in need over the last 50+ years.  
  
We own or license a portfolio of recognized brands including SeaWorld®, Busch Gardens®, Sesame Place® and Sea Rescue®. Over our more than 50-year history, we have built a diversified portfolio of 12 destination and regional theme parks that are grouped in key markets across the United States. Many of our parks showcase our one-of-a-kind zoological collection and all of our parks feature a diverse array of thrill and family rides, shows, educational demonstrations and/or other attractions with broad demographic appeal which deliver memorable experiences and a strong value proposition for our guests.  
  
We have also produced Parent’s Choice and Emmy Award winning shows like Sea Rescue and The Wildlife Docs that celebrate real & inspirational stories of rescue, rehabilitation and return to the wild by the animal rescue, animal care and veterinary teams at SeaWorld and Busch Gardens, in cooperation with our partners also committed to care for wildlife in need.

At Spark® Therapeutics, we believe in a world where no life is limited by disease.
